source_summary: Tall vertical Chinese landscape painting with inscriptions and seals in the upper paper area; reusable motifs are drawn only from the landscape imagery and exclude calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, and paper texture.

motifs.name: left_distant_needle_peaks
motifs.description: Pale, narrow background mountain spires rising behind the main left massif, including the tallest thin green-gray peak and adjacent angular peaks fading into mist.

motifs.name: upper_central_crag
motifs.description: Dominant upper rocky crag at center-left with rounded summit masses, ochre-green washes, dense moss dots, and layered cliff fissures.
must_preserve: ochre and pale green mineral color accents
vertical fracture lines and dry-brush texture

motifs.name: middle_cliff_wall
motifs.description: Large central cliff wall and buttress below the upper crag, including the dark blue-green vertical rock face on the right and layered ledges across the middle.
must_preserve: dark blue-green wash on right cliff face

motifs.name: left_waterfall_gorge
motifs.description: Narrow waterfall and shaded gorge running down the left side of the mountain, with white cascading water between dark rock banks and sparse trees.
must_preserve: dark ink outlines at waterfall edges
small bare branches and shrubs beside the falls

motifs.name: foreground_pine_boulder
motifs.description: Large foreground boulder crowned by spreading gnarled pines, with twisting tan trunks, dark needle clusters, hanging foliage, and surrounding rock forms.
must_preserve: cracked rock outlines and moss dots

motifs.name: scholar_stream_base
motifs.description: Small seated scholar figure near the stream at the foot of the pine slope, with nearby white water, path-like ground, roots, and small rock edges.
must_preserve: small surrounding rock and bank contours

motifs.name: right_misty_mountains
motifs.description: Layered distant mountains on the right, including pale green sloping hills, a darker rear peak, soft mist gaps, and tree-dot bands along the lower ridges.

motifs.name: lower_right_river_sandbar
motifs.description: Open lower-right water surface with low ink shoreline, sandbar shapes, scattered dark ripples, and pale misty water wash.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
